easyPrerequisites: There are at least three counters among creatures you control.
description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Magus of the Bridge trigger
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token that enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve the Phantom Train, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 1, causing you to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat.
